log.text: New build while the owner is away. Estimate about 2 hours.
Personality works: 5 presets (Balanced, Coach, Calm, Playful, Brief) plus your own, ready for MONTY. Safety rules stay fixed underneath.
Calendar (any service, read-only), reminders, and the cheaper memory review all work. 68 tests pass.
Personality picker, reminders and calendar are in the app. Fixed a test that broke its own server requests. 79 tests pass.
Personality, calendar, reminders and the cheaper memory review are documented. Plan is at 15 of 26 done.
Committed and pushed. 79 tests pass. Awoo!
